name: Suggest mapping from file
description: Call this when you have a CSV file of contacts and want the system to propose how its columns map to contact attributes before performing an import. Use the contacts.import_contacts action instead if you are ready to actually import the data.

file.description: CSV file containing contacts to import.

import_field_delimiter.description: Delimiter used to separate fields in the CSV file, e.g., ',' or ';'.

action.description: Indicates that this entry is a mapping suggestion.

type.description: Optional type information for the attribute.

confidence_score.description: Confidence score (0‑1) for the suggested mapping.

data.description: Sample values from the uploaded file that led to this suggestion.

mappings.description: Dictionary where each key is a contact attribute and the value contains the suggested mapping details.

side_effects: Provides suggested attribute mappings for the uploaded CSV file.

internal_endpoint.body_example:
------WebKitFormBoundaryBJG3pKNWGJYlBIVN

Content-Type: text/csv


------WebKitFormBoundaryBJG3pKNWGJYlBIVN

,
